items.originalTitle: Why another Ferrari pole bid faltered
items.summaryEn: Ferrari missed out on pole position in Austin, with Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton finishing fourth and fifth, and Leclerc pointed to tyre warm-up and a drop in temperature in Q3 as the main reasons.
detailZh: 周五练习赛最快车队法拉利在2026年第18次未能夺得大奖赛杆位，这次是在奥斯汀，原因是两个熟悉的弱点和不利的时机。
夏尔·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿最终位列第四和第五，但两人对于为何无法匹敌基米·安东内利的梅赛德斯和两辆红牛略有不同看法。
今年的法拉利一直受困于单圈轮胎弱点，这使它在全年大部分时间里周六弱于周日。
“这非常令人失望，因为我认为有些周末我们在自由练习中很强，但到了排位赛，很明显其他人在直道上快得多，我们很难匹配，”周五最快车手勒克莱尔说。
“但我觉得这是一场我们赛车有潜力的排位赛，不过赛车也包括轮胎，而在Q3中，不幸的是，我们没能处在正确的位置。”
“Q3时温度大概低了1°C或2°C，对我来说，这是巨大的差别。出场圈就真的很挣扎。”
“从出场圈开始我就滑动得相当厉害，这让之后变得非常困难。”
勒克莱尔呼吁法拉利“更加努力，尝试非常透彻地理解这些轮胎，甚至比我们现在做得更好，因为我认为其他人通常拥有更多一点”。
他说：“他们在第三节排位赛中提取圈速比我们容易一些。一旦我们稍微偏离窗口，就会付出很大代价。所以这是我们需要研究的问题。”
尽管进行了多次升级，这仍然是法拉利全年的一大特征，因此这引出了一个问题：这是否是赛车理念中固有的东西，直到2027年才能解决。
当The Race向勒克莱尔提出这一理论时，他说：“不，我不会这么说，但这可能是你必须在正赛和排位赛之间做出选择的一种妥协。”
同样的弱点导致它在排位赛中难以让轮胎保持在正确窗口，但在正赛中却是保护轮胎的优势。
这就是为什么勒克莱尔预计周日的情况会更好，就像在斯帕等赛道上那样，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿在排位赛获得第五和第六名后，正赛分别以第二和第四名完赛。
至于汉密尔顿，他并不觉得轮胎温度是个问题。“我的出场圈非常好，所以对我来说没有问题。赛车感觉很好，那一圈很干净。真的完全没有问题，”他说。
相反，他将法拉利的主要弱点归结为差距的原因。
法拉利在2026年最大的单一弱点一直是其动力单元，这在奥斯汀再次让他们付出了代价，尤其是在长长的后直道上。
汉密尔顿在排位赛中获得第五名后感到意外，得知自己的名次后，他对比赛工程师卡洛·桑蒂说：“这些家伙在Q3最后一圈肯定提速了，因为那段时间去哪了？”
但数据并未显示太多这方面的证据，因为法拉利在所有三个阶段排位赛中的直线速度劣势是一致的。实际上，勒克莱尔在后直道末端比汉密尔顿慢5公里/小时，比安东内利慢10公里/小时。
汉密尔顿（绿线）在到达后直道时比安东内利（基准线）快近十分之一秒——事实上在那个时间点汉密尔顿和勒克莱尔净排名是1-2——但到后直道末端时，汉密尔顿落后多达十分之二秒。
“我们的赛车非常扎实，也许比其他人稍好一些，”汉密尔顿说。
“但我认为他们在底盘方面已经追近了。我们看到红牛在降低阻力方面追近了。梅赛德斯至少带来了零点三秒的升级。我认为他们开始弄清楚如何利用这一点了。”
“所以他们在弯道中现在与我们匹敌。我们无法在本赛季迈出那一步，在直道上缩小那速度差距。”
当被问及红牛在直道上的相对速度时，汉密尔顿说：“有些地方是零点三到零点五秒。也许是零点四秒。这相当令人印象深刻。我不知道你们有没有看过叠加图——进入1号弯时，我们的速度开始下降，而他们的速度则继续保持。”
“所以这很难与之竞争。如果我们拥有和他们相同的动力，我们就会直接参与战斗。我认为我们很可能能进入头排。”
“但我们知道情况就是这样，所以我们会尽量加以利用。”
汉密尔顿0.276秒的差距中有一部分曾被短暂追回，但他最终在最后一个弯出弯时出现了小失误，这让他失去了击败勒克莱尔的机会，甚至可能错失插入两辆红牛之间的机会。
时机不巧？
勒克莱尔在Q3的圈速实际上比他在Q2的最佳成绩还要慢，如果重复那一圈，他本可以排在基米·安东内利旁边占据头排发车位。
勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿实际上是仅有的两位在Q3中合法提升成绩的车手，他们的圈速优于其他任何人的最后一搏。不幸的是，对法拉利而言，安东内利和红牛车手在Q3首轮冲刺中已做出更快圈速。
哈贾尔：1分34.363秒（因超出赛道限制被删除）
诺里斯：1分34.379秒（因超出赛道限制被删除）
维斯塔潘：1分34.482秒（因超出赛道限制被删除）
看起来，法拉利确实是在赛道条件相比梅赛德斯/红牛显得更不利时做出了Q3最快圈，当时风力更大、云层更厚，且出现在本节稍晚阶段。
最终，它可能为未能在后来被证明至关重要的Q3首轮跑中同样出色地执行而付出了代价，当时它仅列第四和第六。
detailEn: Friday Formula 1 pacesetter Ferrari fell short of a grand prix pole position for the 18th time in 2026, this time at Austin, because of two familiar weaknesses and unfortunate timing.
Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton ended up fourth and fifth but had slightly different views on why they could not match Kimi Antonelli's Mercedes and the two Red Bulls.
This year's Ferrari has battled a single-lap tyre weakness that has left it weaker on Saturdays than Sundays for much of the year.

"It's very disappointing because I think there are some other weekends where we've been strong in free practice, but then come quali, it's very clear that the others are just having a lot more in the straights, and it's very difficult for us to match that," Friday pacesetter Leclerc said.
"But I felt like it's a qualifying where we had the potential in the car, but the car also includes tyres, and in Q3, unfortunately, we were not in the right place.
"It was like 1°C or 2°C less in Q3, and for me, it was a huge difference. Just really struggled in the outlap.
"I was sliding quite a lot already from the outlap, and that made it very difficult after that."
Leclerc called on Ferrari to "work harder and try and understand those tyres very well, even better than what we are doing now, because the others I think normally have a bit more".

"It's a bit easier for them to extract the laptime in Q3 than it is for us," he said. "As soon as we are a tiny bit outside the window, we pay the price a lot. So this is something that we need to look into."

It has been a characteristic of the Ferrari throughout the year despite multiple upgrades, so that raises the question of whether it is something intrinsic to the car philosophy that can't be fixed until 2027.
"No, I wouldn't say that, but it's maybe a bit of a compromise that you would have to choose between race and qualifying," Leclerc said when The Race put that theory to him.
The same weakness that leaves it struggling to keep its tyres in the right window in qualifying is a tyre preservation strength in the races.
It's why Leclerc expected things to be better on Sunday, as was the case at races such as Spa, where Leclerc and Hamilton finished second and fourth after qualifying fifth and sixth.
As for Hamilton, he didn't feel tyre temperature was an issue. "I had a really good out lap, so no problems for me. The car felt good, it was a clean lap. No issues at all, really," he said.
Instead, he zeroed in on Ferrari's main weakness as the cause of the deficit.
Ferrari's single-biggest weakness in 2026 has been its power unit and that cost it once again at Austin, in particular down the long back straight.

Hamilton was caught off guard by qualifying fifth and after being informed of his position, he told his race engineer Carlo Santi: "These guys must be turning it up for that last Q3, because where did that time go?"

But the data did not show much evidence of that as Ferrari's straightline deficit is consistent throughout all three stages of qualifying. Leclerc is actually 5km/h down on Hamilton at the end of the back straight, and 10km/h down on Antonelli.

Hamilton (green line) is almost a tenth up on Antonelli (baseline) as they reach the back straight - in fact Hamilton and Leclerc are a net 1-2 at that snapshot in time - but by the time they're at the end of it Hamilton slipped as far as two tenths back.
"Our car is really solid, maybe slightly better than the others," Hamilton said.

"But I think they have closed up on chassis. We've seen the Red Bull close up on their downforce. Mercedes took a three-tenths step of upgrade, at least. I think they're starting to figure out how to utilise that.
"So they're now matching us through the corners. We're not able to take that step in this season to close that speed on the straight."

Asked about the comparative straightline speed of the Red Bull, Hamilton said: "Some places it's three to five tenths. Maybe it's four tenths. It's pretty impressive. I don't know if you've seen the overlays - Into Turn 1, ours starts dipping and theirs just keeps going.
"So that's hard to compete with. If we had the same power as them, we would be right there in the battle. I think we could probably be on the front row.
"But we know that's the case, so we try to make the most of it."

Some of Hamilton's 0.276s deficit was briefly reclaimed, but Hamilton ended up making a small error out of the final corner that cost him the chance of beating Leclerc and potentially even splitting the Red Bulls.
Unfortunate timing?
Leclerc's Q3 lap was actually slower than his best Q2 effort, which, if repeated, would have put him on the front row alongside Kimi Antonelli.

Leclerc and Hamilton were actually the only two drivers to legally improve on their Q3 run with laptimes better than anyone else's final efforts. Unfortunately for Ferrari, Antonelli and the Red Bulls had set better laps on their first Q3 runs.
Hadjar: 1m34.363s (track limits deleted)
Norris: 1m34.379s (track limits deleted)
Verstappen: 1m34.482s (track limits deleted)

It does appear the Ferraris set their fastest Q3 laps when the track conditions looked less favourable compared to the Mercedes/Red Bulls, with gustier winds and more cloud cover later in the session.
Ultimately, it may have paid the price for not executing as well on what turned out to be crucial first Q3 runs, where it was fourth and sixth.
keyPointsZh: 这是法拉利2026年第18次未能夺得大奖赛杆位。
勒克莱尔称Q3气温比之前低约1至2摄氏度，他在出场圈就打滑严重。
keyPointsEn: This was the 18th time in 2026 that Ferrari failed to take a grand prix pole position.
Leclerc said Q3 was about 1-2°C cooler and that he was already sliding a lot on the outlap.

Britain's Alisha Palmowski became the 2026 F1 Academy champion with three races to spare after building an unassailable lead in Austin.

Palmowski followed up victory in Friday's Opening Race at the Circuit of the Americas with second in the Reverse Grid Race behind Alba Larsen to take a 70-point lead over her closest championship challenger, Emme Felbermayr, with only a maximum if 67 points remaining.
The Red Bull-backed has dominated this season by winning five of the 11 races so far with six pole positions to become the second Briton after Abbi Pulling in 2024 to win the F1 Academy title.

Palmowski, 20, is the youngest F1 Academy champion and praised the team and her family, who were in attendance in Austin.
"We did it guys! It's incredible. I don't know what to say. I'm trying not to cry!" she said.
"There's so much hard work gone on behind the scenes, not just from myself, but all the people you won't see. They have lived it day and night.
"We have worked so hard as a team, Campos Racing and Red Bull Racing. We have left no stone unturned. I don't want to name names but my engineer Diego has lived this with me every day and night."

Palmowski has won the title in her second full campaign after an impressive rookie season where she won the 2025 season-opener and took another four podiums.
She has been backed by Red Bull since the start of last year after finishing as runners-up in the 2024 GB4 Championship.
"I've learned so much in the last 18 months to two years being with Red Bull," she said.
"I learned about things I didn't know. I've developed so much, not only as a driver but a person as well. I've matured so much in the last 12 months. It's a dream come true."
Alisha Palmowski discusses her championship-winning F1 Academy campaign
What next for Palmowski?
Previous F1 Academy champions Marta Garcia, Pulling and Doriane Pin have gone on to race in other motorsport categories in endurance racing and Formula Regional.
Palmowski, who starts on pole for Sunday's main race in Austin at 5pm, live on Sky Sports F1, may now look to make a similar move in 2027.
"There are conversations happening in the background but I'm leaving that to my management team," she told Sky Sports F1.
"I want to go as far up the single-seater ladder as possible but I'm aware motorsport is a results-based business.
"I'm a big believer that when you go in a car, the helmet goes on, the car doesn't have a gender and we are fighting for the same thing."

detailZh: 美国大奖赛：在奥斯汀周日正赛从杆位发车的基米·安东内利，赢得2026年F1车手世界冠军的可能性有多大？
基米·安东内利在奥斯汀周日正赛从杆位发车，身旁是马克斯·维斯塔潘，那么他今天赢得世界冠军的机会如何？周日晚8点在天空体育F1与天空体育主赛事频道直播美国大奖赛，6点30分开始赛前节目。
克雷格·斯莱特解释基米·安东内利如何能在美国大奖赛锁定F1世界冠军。
梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫认为，尽管意大利人从杆位发车，基米·安东内利在周日美国大奖赛赢得2026年F1车手世界冠军“并不现实”。
安东内利原本并不被看好能在排位赛中拿下头名，但他在第三节排位赛中跑出一圈精彩飞驰，击败红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘，自七月比利时大奖赛以来首次夺得杆位。
如果安东内利在周日奥斯汀的正赛中获胜，同时刘易斯·汉密尔顿获得第五名或更低、乔治·拉塞尔获得第九名或更低，他就将在剩余五站的情况下锁定年度总冠军。

然而，沃尔夫警告说梅赛德斯将没有足够的速度获胜，因为他们在周五练习的长距离跑中没有速度。
“我们不是在谈论那个[总冠军]。这不现实，”他告诉天空体育F1。
“我不认为我们在正赛中最快，所以关键在于得分，并最终有望获胜。”
安东内利为美国大奖赛夺得杆位
安东内利也警惕红牛的正赛速度，以及排在第二的维斯塔潘和第三的伊萨克·哈贾尔也可能联手合作的可能性。
他承认本周“有些不同”，因为他知道这是以20岁之龄成为这项运动最年轻世界冠军的首次机会。
安东内利说：“目标保持不变。我只需要继续做好自己的工作，实际上，我觉得我能更多地享受驾驶和一切。”
“但当然，我们仍然必须完成比赛，仍然必须努力争胜，然后当然，我们会看看会发生什么。但是，我觉得我能更多地享受它，因为显然我处于非常有利的位置。不过，心态始终如一。”
2026年美国大奖赛排位赛的精彩片段。
维斯塔潘计划在对阵安东内利时“保持尊重”
起步时通往宽阔的1号弯的上坡路段，为排在第二位的车手提供了从内线超越杆位车手的好机会，如果维斯塔潘起步强劲，他可能会尝试这么做。
维斯塔潘赢下了最近两场比赛，实际上没有什么可失去的，但他表示不会对积分榜领先者安东内利过于激进。
“基米想要争胜，对吧？这有助于他在积分榜上的位置，”他告诉天空体育F1。
“我们保持尊重，并努力赢得比赛。”
周五在奥斯汀的各节练习中轮胎磨损很高，但本赛季多场比赛也是如此，最终正赛却变成了一停比赛，因为车队调整了赛车设置，赛道在周末过程中抓地力也提升了。
尽管如此，超车仍有可能，维斯塔潘显得低调而自信，力争实现三连胜，并让安东内利无缘在周日夺冠。
“我们在长距离中更满意，希望明天也能如此，”他说。
在美国大奖赛之前，马克斯·维斯塔潘讨论了红牛车队下赛季争夺总冠军的目标。
至于拉塞尔，这又是一个棘手的周末，他面临着巨大的挑战，要超越身前的法拉利车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿和查尔斯·勒克莱尔，这两位车手在练习赛中都很快速，以进入领奖台的争夺。
拉塞尔一直无法掌握梅赛德斯的新升级套件，但他承认自己只是在Q3中跑了"两圈糟糕的圈速"。
"我认为我本可以进入前三名。我在Q2的圈速比我在Q3中跑出的成绩快了两秒半，但显然这对我来说还不够好，"他告诉天空体育F1。
当被问及比赛前景时，他说：“我认为这是一场漫长的比赛，在奥斯汀这里会发生很多事情。策略会发挥作用，所以仍然有机会。”

detailEn: United States GP: How likely is pole-sitter Kimi Antonelli to win 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship on Sunday in Austin?

Kimi Antonelli starts on pole position for Sunday's race in Austin from Max Verstappen, so what are his chances of winning the championship today? Watch the United States GP live on Sky Sports F1 & Sky Sports Main Event at 8pm on Sunday, with build up from 6.30pm
Craig Slater explains how Kimi Antonelli can clinch the F1 world title at the United States Grand Prix

Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff believes it is "not realistic" for Kimi Antonelli to win the 2026 F1 Drivers' Championship on Sunday at the United States Grand Prix, despite the Italian starting on pole position.
Antonelli was not expected to claim top spot in qualifying but produced a superb lap in Q3 to beat Red Bull's Max Verstappen and take his first pole position since July's Belgian Grand Prix.
Should Antonelli win Sunday's race in Austin with Lewis Hamilton finishing fifth or lower and George Russell ninth or lower, he will seal the title with five rounds remaining.

Hamilton will start fifth and Russell sixth when the lights go out at the Circuit of the Americas at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm), live on Sky Sports F1 and Main Event.
However, Wolff has warned Mercedes will not have the pace to win as they did not have the pace in Friday practice's long runs.
"We are not talking about that [the championship]. It's not realistic," he told Sky Sports F1.
"I don't think we are quickest in the race, so it's about scoring points and eventually, hopefully, winning."
Kimi Antonelli takes pole for the United States Grand Prix
Antonelli is also wary of Red Bull's race pace and the possibility Verstappen in second and Isack Hadjar in third can also work together.
He admits this week has been "a bit different", knowing it is the first opportunity to become the sport's youngest world champion at 20 years old.
"The goal stays the same. I just need to keep doing my job, and actually, I feel like I can enjoy the driving and everything more," said Antonelli.

"But of course, we still have to do the race, still have to try and win, and then, of course, we'll see what happens. But, I feel like I can enjoy it a bit more because obviously I'm in a very good position. But still, the mindset is always the same."
Highlights from qualifying for the 2026 United States Grand Prix.
Verstappen plans to 'keep it respectful' against Antonelli

The uphill run towards the wide Turn 1 at the start provides a good opportunity for the driver in second to steam up the inside of the pole-sitter, something Verstappen may look to do if he has a strong getaway.
Verstappen, who has won the last two races, effectively has nothing to lose but suggested he will not be excessively aggressive against championship leader Antonelli.
"Kimi wants to go for the win right? That helps his position in the championship," he told Sky Sports F1.
"We keep it respectful and try to win the race."

Tyre degradation was high in Friday's practice sessions in Austin but that has been the case at several races this season, only for the Grand Prix to turn into a one-stop race as the teams have changed the setup on their cars and the track has gripped up over the weekend.
Nevertheless, overtaking is possible and Verstappen cut a quietly confident figure to make it a hat-trick of wins and deny any chance Antonelli has of winning the title on Sunday.
"We have been happier in the long runs, and I hope that it will be the same tomorrow," he said.
Ahead of the United States Grand Prix, Max Verstappen discusses Red Bull's Championship title aims for next season

As for Russell, it has been another tricky weekend and he faces a big challenge to overtake Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc in front of him, who have both been quick in practice, to get into the podium fight.
Russell has been unable to get to grips with Mercedes' new upgrade package but admits he simply just did "two bad laps in Q3".
"I think I could have been in the top three. My Q2 lap was two and a half tenths quicker than what I achieved in Q3 but that obviously isn't good enough from my side," he told Sky Sports F1.
Asked about his race prospects, he said: "I think it's a long race, a lot happens here in Austin. Strategy plays a role so still opportunities."
